how_to_obtain.version_warning: Both manuscripts use v4.5.1. If you obtain a different version the sha256 below will not match. That is not a failure of the audit -- it is a fact worth reporting, because a claim reproduced on a different release is a weaker reproduction than one on the same bytes.
